character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Create a legendary Excelsior Armor skin for the existing warrior. Replace his original armor with magnificent silver-white plate armor, decorated with elegant golden edges and subtle sacred engravings. The chestplate and shoulder guards should appear stronger and more imposing, with a noble, divine appearance. Add a long dark red or deep burgundy cape flowing behind him, enhancing his heroic and sacred presence. Add a faint warm golden radiance around the armor, suggesting celestial protection. Preserve the warrior's face, hair, proportions, sword, shield and original idle pose.
